//: Coverage is measured over the COMPILED output, because that is what the test runner executes (`node --test build/**/*.test.js`). `excludeAfterRemap` makes the exclude patterns below apply to the ORIGINAL src/*.ts paths after source-map remapping, which is why they are written in src/ terms even though `src` points at build/. Thresholds are the Phase-5 levels of TESTING.md §Coverage (the servicenow-mcp donor levels: lines 94 / branches 82 / functions 97); the donor pins no statements floor, so ours is set to the same value as lines, which is what tsc output makes it in practice. They sit a few points under the measured tree on purpose: a threshold is a floor that must not creep down, not a target to chase. `check-coverage` below makes any c8 run fail when one of them is missed, and `npm run check` runs the suite under c8 (`test:coverage`) — the gate enforces these floors; plain `npm run test` stays uninstrumented for quick loops.
